runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies 180 days after it is issued. It covers any contract awarded under a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum. The same 180-day date also governs any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after that point.

The memo does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.

The excerpts I retrieved do not give the memo's exact issue date, so I can't convert the 180 days into a calendar date.
